components: service.config / service.db / service.models - settings, async engine, Link model (UTC-safe timestamps)
service.domain.codes - base62 CSPRNG codes, alias validation, reserved words
service.links.LinkService + service.repository - use cases and SQL
data_model: links(id, code UNIQUE, target_url, is_custom, tags JSON, disabled, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, idempotency_key UNIQUE, request_fingerprint)

decisions.rationale: 301 is cached forever by browsers, breaking disable/delete and analytics

decisions.decision: 7-char random base62 codes with bounded retry
decisions.rationale: 62^7 = 3.5e12; per-insert collision p = n/62^7; no central counter to coordinate
keeps audit history and prevents silent alias re-use

decisions.decision: Idempotency-Key stored on the link with a request fingerprint
